methodSections.heading: Sherry Vinaigrette
steps: Place the oil and vinegar in a bottle, shake, taste and adjust seasoning.

methodSections.heading: Escalivada
steps: Pierce the eggplant with a knife in a few places, place on an oven tray with the peppers and coat with a touch of olive oil.
Roast for approximately 1 hour at 200°C (400 F), turning the peppers after around 30 minutes.
When cool enough to touch peel the skin from the eggplant and skin and deseed the peppers. Cut the eggplant lengthwise into 2cm (¾in) strips and the peppers in two.
Plate them arranged like a flag on a tray with parchment paper, drizzle with a touch of olive oil and re-heat in the oven,
Transfer to a serving plate and season with sherry vinaigrette, sea salt, fresh ground pepper.
Shave the Manchego evenly over the top, scatter some torn basil and drizzle with some olive oil.
